info.name: InventoTrack
info.description: InventoTrack API tests with login. Run folder 0 first. Change the base_url variable to test local (http://127.0.0.1:5000) or live (https://invento-track.onrender.com).

item.name: 0 - Login (run these FIRST)

request.description: Saves the token automatically. Every other request uses it.
Saves the staff token for the staff tests.
Protected route without a token.

item.description: Run the two login requests before anything else.

request.description: Uses a unique email each run so it always succeeds.
Check the response: price_per_unit must be missing.
sold_by is taken from the token automatically.
Expect is_restricted false. Running again creates a duplicate row.
Expect is_restricted true, plus restricted_match, restricted_reason and warning.

request.description: Partial name match: still flagged.
Case is ignored: still flagged.

item.name: Get batches for product 1 (owner sees price)
Add EXPIRED batch to product 20 (FIFO test)

request.description: Adds 12 fresh units to product 20 so the FIFO sales below always have stock.
Works when the oldest valid batch holds fewer units than the quantity sold.
Spaces only counts as EMPTY. Product 7 = Paraquat (restricted).
Buyer ID must be at least 4 characters.
Creates a record that will show in the compliance log.
Owner only. Check summary: with_buyer_id + missing_buyer_id = total_records.

item.name: Compliance log - only sales with NO buyer ID

request.description: Old seed sales appear here because they were made before the product was flagged.
Units sold per month. The unfinished current month is left out; empty months are 0.
Three methods compared, season-aware model used for seasonal products.
Year-round products use whichever method had the smallest test error.

item.name: Forecast - product with no sales (enough_data false)

request.description: Neem Oil has no sales history: expect enough_data false and a message.
Public route. Cold start can take 20-30 seconds after idle.

exec: pm.test('Has reasoning', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.why).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.recommended_order).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(['forecast','minimum_stock_rule']).to.include(j.basis); });
